proposals.subject: proposal.weather.rain

basis.rationale: Explicit Oteryn design choice where inspected sources do not establish a complete current Global value.

assumptions: Visual-only preset; no damage, speed or gameplay visibility penalty. Normalized units are proposed renderer inputs; native architecture must accept mapping before implementation. No global weather equivalence claimed.
